Initial release of openclaw-business-guide

- Provides a comprehensive guide for monetizing OpenClaw, aimed at freelancers, entrepreneurs, and side hustlers.
- Details four main revenue streams: installation services, Skills development, technical consulting, and enterprise deployment.
- Includes pricing strategies, customer acquisition channels, and conversion funnel breakdowns.
- Offers automation examples for content publishing, client replies, and order processing.
- Shares income projections for the first, third, and sixth months.
- Lists available consulting and support options with contact information.
